meaning: Compose the existing typed immutableIsBoethianEternal theorem with the explicit one-way recognition transfer to the EXACT all-beings ImmutableIsEternalReading root premise. Succession-to-subject-potency, boundary-to-subject-potency, and pure-act-has-life stay separately visible. No inference from immutable to alive is hidden in a definition.

strong_version_needed.812b52b3-de7d-5982-93a9-e46b6e169616: Its pure-act conclusion quantifies over potency in the subject (MUTABLE_1), so the boundary premise is needed in that sense; the weaker MUTABLE_3 reading STMT-LIFE-BOUNDARY-REQUIRES-SOME-MUTABILITY reaches it only with the open bridge STMT-SUBJECT-OF-ANOTHERS-POWER-HAS-POTENCY (LIFE-BOUNDARY-POTENCY-FROM-SOME-MUTABILITY; batch 4 of #1233).
strong_version_needed.1773079b-236a-5f7d-b1e9-fb8f23202341: The conclusion ImmutableIsEternalReading is about every being in potency in no respect, through the typed Boethian eternity of each, whose possession-of-life conjunct is needed at each of them; the weak version (whatever has the nine is LIVING_2) covers only pure acts that also have the other eight of the nine (DeiFiliusLivingNineScope.Control.Controls part 2).

label: What is altogether IMMUTABLE_1, in potency in no respect, is ETERNAL_1…, from typed boethian
